source: The renderer is compiled with a set of constants. Nuxt fills in every one it can work out from {0}. The rest, anything that depends on route rules, on a page matcher, or on a file you emit, starts out set to "feature off". Pass {1} to replace those with your own values, written as JavaScript expressions:
